title: Looking for testers?
author: cookiecutter178
selftext:
Hey everyone — I’m looking for traders who are interested in helping test a new AI trading tool.  
We’re looking for people who actively trade and are willing to give honest feedback on how useful the tool is, how accurate the insights are etc etc.

There are cash incentives and more of it available for selected testers, and there may be opportunities for more involvement in the future.  
If you’re interested in testing it out, comment or DM me and I’ll send over the details.
